items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I played with him. You played with him? Yeah.

ctx.x: Jake Stevens, did I tell you about him playing?
Nick Stevens? Yeah. No I don't think he did. Well I played with him. You played with him? Yeah. Did he play something too?
Yeah he played corner too. Uh huh.
